Review of determination criteria (retained this time): Amount ≤100 yuan and satisfaction of responsibility on our side, complete documentation, no platform involvement, direct refund with very low risk; 101-500 yuan must be manually verified; >500 yuan must be manually reviewed and approved by the supervisor. Conclusion level: If the entire order is unavailable or the customer insists on a full refund→ a full refund; Same style can be exchanged → exchanged; Only missing parts → reissued; Partial refund for compensation for goods retention →;严重度：金额档 ≤100 记 0 分、101-500 记 1 分、>500 记 2 分； Leakage/contamination demerit 2 points; Platform intervention or escalation of complaints deducts 1 point; Cumulative 0-1 mild, 2-3 average, 4-5 severe, 6 or above very severe.
Substituting this order: Amount 388 yuan, deduct 1 point + leakage pollution 2 points + platform intervention 1 point = 4 points.
